0022600035.text: The Bucks (1-10) are on a seven-game losing streak, 0-5 on the road, and sit 15th in the East and 6.5 games back in the Central, while the Orlando Magic (3-7) enter on a one-game winning streak and are 11th in the East. Myles Turner is out for Milwaukee due to rest, and Orlando is missing seven players: Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jamal Cain (shoulder bruise), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), and Tristan da Silva (calf strain). The teams have not met yet this season, and in their last meeting, on March 8, 2026 in Milwaukee, Orlando won 130-91; the Bucks lost the 2025-26 series 1-2.
